failureCases.message: hate @user useless crap. it sees my local files but many are grey out. what a rubbish player.
failureCases.escalationReason: Auto-handled: content availability issue resolved with standard KB steps
failureCases.reply:
Hey @user, sorry you’re seeing greyed‑out local files. That usually happens when the files aren’t in the right folder or aren’t in a supported format. Try these steps:
1️⃣ Open the app and go to Settings > Local Files.
2️⃣ Make sure the folder you’re pointing to contains only MP3, M4A, or WAV files.
3️⃣ If you’ve moved the folder, click “Refresh” or restart the app.
4️⃣ If the files still appear grey, double‑check that the folder is on a local drive (not a network share).
If you’re still stuck, DM us with the folder path and a few file names and we’ll dig deeper. Thanks for your patience!
